name: Design fictional countries and their political systems
description: Users asked to design fictional countries, nations, or political entities by specifying details such as names, flags, history, demographics, and governance systems. These requests often involved creating alternate geopolitics, identifying real-world historical inspirations for game factions, or defining characteristics for hypothetical states in games and creative writing.
